label: cost
notes: Cold requests have unique cache salts. Warm-prefix decode reuses the corresponding seed-request salt only for its paired timed request; its cached-input/TTFT ratios are omitted. Thinking on uses GLM native high effort. Client effective prefill includes scheduling and first-token work; decode uses completion usage minus one over first-to-last streamed delta. Speculative decoding may return multiple tokens in a delta. Backend metrics are saved separately.
